input.quote: Such audit shall not occur more than [***] in a given Calendar Year, unless for cause, and shall not concern books and records relating to a period more than [***] preceding the current Calendar Year.
input.rationale: Section 9.9 is the only audit right reaching Sanofi (Section 6.9 runs the other way and benefits us, so it is not flagged). Structurally the clause already sits at or above our position: audits are by an "independent auditor of international prominence" reasonably acceptable to the audited Party (9.9(a)), the auditor and auditing Party are bound by confidentiality (9.9(d)), review is limited to books and records maintained under Section 9.8 (no systems access), the auditing Party bears the full cost absent an underpayment, and prior written notice plus a once-per-Calendar-Year cap are contemplated. The problem is that the three fallback parameters - frequency, notice period and the cost-shifting underpayment threshold - are all redacted ([***]), so we cannot confirm the fallback floors of once per year, 15 days' notice and a 10% threshold are met. We have therefore proposed a minimal mutual edit inserting those fallback figures; if the executed values are already at or better than these, no change is needed. Minor points noted but not redlined: the clause does not expressly require business hours or off-site review, and it permits additional audits "for cause", which we regard as a customary carve-out.

proposal.summary: Fill the redacted audit parameters in Section 9.9 at our fallback: once per Calendar Year, 15 days' prior notice, and cost-shifting only above a 10% underpayment.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The audit parameters in Section 9.9 are redacted, so we cannot confirm they meet our position. We have set them at our fallback - one audit per Calendar Year, at least 15 days' prior notice, and audit costs shifting only where the underpayment exceeds 10% - on a mutual basis, leaving the rest of the clause unchanged.

ops.oldText: but in any event at least [***] prior notice
ops.newText: but in any event at least fifteen (15) days' prior notice

ops.oldText: Such audit shall not occur more than [***] in a given Calendar Year
ops.newText: Such audit shall not occur more than one time in a given Calendar Year

ops.oldText: which underpayment was more than [***] percent
ops.newText: which underpayment was more than ten percent (10%)

mappings.element: Vendor may audit no more than once per year.
Vendor must give at least 15 days' notice of an audit.
Vendor bears audit costs unless underpayment exceeds 10 percent.
